moments.title: Premier League weekend kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season continues this weekend with a packed schedule of matches across the UK, including Hull vs Man Utd and Newcastle vs Liverpool.

angles.name: Saturday's Highlights
angles.copy: Premier League action is LIVE today! Hull City vs Manchester United (12:30 BST), Everton vs Crystal Palace (15:00 BST), Ipswich Town vs Sunderland (15:00 BST), Nottingham Forest vs Leeds United (15:00 BST), and Brentford vs Tottenham Hotspur (17:30 BST). Who are you backing?

angles.name: Super Sunday & Monday Night Football
angles.copy: Don't miss a huge Premier League Sunday: Brighton vs Aston Villa (14:00 BST), Man City vs Bournemouth (14:00 BST), and Newcastle United vs Liverpool (16:30 BST). Plus, Fulham host Chelsea on Monday night (20:00 BST) for a London derby!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival next week
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals return next week, running from August 27-30, 2026, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: FIVE DAYS TO GO until Reading & Leeds Festival 2026 kicks off! Who are you most excited to see on stage next weekend? #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Raye... the Reading & Leeds lineup is HUGE this year! Get ready for a massive Bank Holiday weekend of live music.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made history by securing its 22nd non-consecutive week at Number 1 on the Official Singles Chart, a new UK record.

angles.name: Record-breaking No.1
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is officially the UK's longest-running Number 1 single ever, hitting 22 non-consecutive weeks! What a track!

angles.name: Chart Topper Trivia
angles.copy: 22 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have rewritten the record books with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite Number 1 of all time?

moments.title: Phoebe Bridgers, KATSEYE, The Script new in Albums Chart
moments.blurb: Phoebe Bridgers' 'Lost Weekend' debuts at Number 1 on the Official Albums Chart, with K-Pop group KATSEYE's 'WILD' landing at Number 2 and The Script's 'The User's Guide to Being Human' at Number 3.

angles.name: Album Chart Toppers
angles.copy: New music reigns! Phoebe Bridgers, KATSEYE and The Script all land in the top 3 of the Official Albums Chart this week. What are you streaming?

angles.name: Indie to K-Pop
angles.copy: From Phoebe Bridgers at Number 1 to KATSEYE at Number 2, this week's Official Albums Chart is a diverse mix!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday next week
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, 2026, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Loading
angles.copy: Less than 10 days until the August Bank Holiday! Who's ready for a long weekend? #BankHoliday

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The Bank Holiday on Monday 31st August is almost here – your last chance for a summer celebration before autumn officially arrives!
